title: Curriculum Manager - APM / PM
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for an innovative and versatile Product Manager/Learning Designer/Curriculum Manager with data science expertise to join our growing education technology team. In this multifaceted role, you will lead curriculum development initiatives for AI and Machine Learning programs, combining instructional design excellence with technical expertise. You'll have complete ownership to create market-leading educational experiences that help students master complex technical skills and achieve tangible learning outcomes in the competitive AI landscape.

Responsibilities:

● Use Machine Learning and Data Science domain and Product Management expertise to work on exciting growth projects.

● Do market research, gap analysis and competitor analysis to identify new areas to launch machine learning and related program curriculums.

● Create product-market fit to understand the industry requirements and develop courses to help students meet high standards.

● Quickly learn complex concepts and ensure the quality of content, instructional design and overall course experience.

● Collaborate with the MAANG+ Machine Learning industry expert to design skill-oriented classes, assessments and interview preparation strategies to enable students to achieve tangible learning outcomes.

● Manage the learning experience by iterating over the curriculum and driving the learning outcomes

● Graduates (B Tech/ BE) from Tier 1 / 2 engineering colleges / Tier 1 companies / startups

● 2-3 years of Product/curriculum management/development experience on ML/AI-related courses or Master's in ML/AI-related domains.

● Intelligent and curious people who enjoy learning about Algorithms, Data Structures, Machine Learning and Data Science topics.

● Familiarity with different ML techniques such as Supervised, Unsupervised, Deep Learning etc., along with a strong understanding of Python & different ML libraries such as Numpy, Pandas, Scikit-learn and more.

● Active participation in competitive programming, hackathons, and coding events is desirable.

● Experience or knowledge of MLOps is preferable.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


What will excite you?

● Complete ownership

● Experiment, fail and learn. 

● High pedigree, high calibre team.

● Contribute to every area of our business. Have a real impact on your work

● Top-of-the-line compensation.

title: Manager - Placement Partnerships (US)
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Career Partnerships Manager with a strong background in account management, talent partnerships, or corporate sales focused on the US tech hiring ecosystem. This role is responsible for identifying, nurturing, and converting hiring partner leads into offer-generating relationships for our learners. Success in this role will be measured by actual offers delivered through your hiring partner network.

Key Responsibilities

 - Identify and reach out to hiring managers and technical recruiters in the US, primarily from product companies hiring for domains relevant to IK (AI/ML, Backend, SD, etc.).

 - Use prospecting tools such as Apollo, Sales Navigator, Ocean, and SignalHire to build a quality hiring pipeline.

 - Establish and manage long-term relationships with hiring stakeholders.

 - Understand their hiring needs in-depth and ensure a consistent flow of relevant IK candidates.

 - Own partner engagement from discovery to final offer

 - Share contextualized talent shortlists and follow through until the offer stage.

 - Drive placements actively and meet conversion targets.

 - Maintain performance dashboards and lead quality records.

What We’re Looking For

 - 3–5 years of experience in account management, business development, campus/corporate placements, or tech recruiting, preferably with exposure to the US talent ecosystem.

 - Proven track record of building lead pipelines and driving end-to-end partnerships with outcome ownership.

 - Strong understanding of hiring dynamics in US product companies and comfort navigating job requirements in tech domains.

 - Proficiency in using Apollo (preferred), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Google Sheets, and CRM tools.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills; confident in external stakeholder conversations.

 - High ownership mindset, strong execution capability, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment.

 - Must be open to night shift hours and occasional weekend calls, based on partner availability.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Prior experience in EdTech, bootcamp partnerships, technical staffing, or recruitment solutions.

 - Existing network of technical recruiters or hiring managers in the US.

 - Understanding of Tech hiring trends is a plus.

If you thrive on ownership, results, and working with top talent in tech — we’d love to speak with you.

We are looking for an Associate – Operations (Delivery) to join our Delivery Operations team. The role will be responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of our instructor and mentor ecosystem and supporting the day-to-day delivery of learning programs. The candidate will primarily manage instructor/mentor concerns, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and ensure the right resources are available and deployed effectively to support program delivery.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 - Act as the primary point of contact for instructors and mentors for operational and delivery-related concerns.

 - Understand, address, and resolve instructor/mentor queries related to sessions, schedules, learner batches, assignments, and other delivery requirements.

 - Coordinate with instructors and mentors to ensure smooth execution of scheduled sessions and program activities.

 - Handle escalations professionally and coordinate with relevant internal teams for resolution.

 - Maintain strong relationships with instructors and mentors to ensure a positive working experience.

 - Communicate program updates, processes, schedules, and operational changes to instructors and mentors.

 - Identify recurring challenges faced by instructors/mentors and suggest improvements to existing processes.

 - Coordinate resource allocation based on program requirements, learner batches, schedules, and instructor/mentor availability.

 - Track resource availability, utilization, schedules, and assignments.

 

What We’re Looking For:

 - 1–2 years of experience in Customer Operations, Operations, Program Operations, Delivery Operations, Customer Success, or a similar role.

 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with instructors, mentors, and internal stakeholders.

 - Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and stakeholders simultaneously.

 - Ability to handle escalations and resolve operational concerns with a solution-oriented approach.

 - Strong attention to detail and ownership of assigned responsibilities.

 - Good working knowledge of Google Sheets/Excel and other productivity tools.

 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.

 - Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience in EdTech, education, SaaS, or service-based organizations is preferred.
